description:
Individual tax-return statistics by postcode for each income year 2016-17 to 2023-24: taxpayers, taxable income (average and median), salary, deductions, net tax, rental income and losses, capital gains, super.

Coverage: About 2,570 postcodes across Australia; income years 2016-17 to 2023-24 (8 years). Current to 2024-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/taxation`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: individuals_count, taxable_income_count, taxable_income_total, total_income_count, total_income_total, salary_wages_count, salary_wages_total, net_tax_count, net_tax_total, medicare_levy_surcharge_count, medicare_levy_surcharge_total, help_debt_balance_count, help_debt_balance_total, govt_allowances_payments_count, govt_allowances_payments_total, govt_pensions_allowances_count, govt_pensions_allowances_total, gross_interest_count, gross_interest_total, dividends_franked_count, dividends_franked_total, work_related_expenses_count, work_related_expenses_total, work_related_car_count, work_related_car_total, work_related_self_education_count, work_related_self_education_total, interest_deductions_count, interest_deductions_total, gifts_donations_count, gifts_donations_total, total_deductions_count, total_deductions_total, reportable_employer_super_count, reportable_employer_super_total, personal_super_contributions_count, personal_super_contributions_total, net_capital_gain_count, net_capital_gain_total, gross_rent_count, gross_rent_total, rent_interest_deductions_count, rent_interest_deductions_total, rent_capital_works_count, rent_capital_works_total, rent_other_deductions_count, rent_other_deductions_total, net_rent_profit_count, net_rent_profit_total, net_rent_loss_count, net_rent_loss_total, net_rent_count, net_rent_total, business_net_income_count, business_net_income_total, private_health_insurance_count, average_taxable_income, median_taxable_income, average_salary_wages, median_salary_wages, average_net_rent, median_net_rent, average_total_income, median_total_income, average_total_deductions, median_total_deductions, average_business_income, median_business_income, average_net_tax, median_net_tax, average_super_balance, median_super_balance, share_with_net_rental_loss_pct, share_giving_to_charity_pct, share_with_private_health_insurance_pct. Omit for all.
